description.en: The cloud computer policy IDs. You can specify 1 to 100 policies.

description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~DescribeRegions~~) operation to query the regions supported by EDS.

title.zh: 删除一个或多个自定义云电脑策略

descriptions.zh:
- 系统云电脑策略不允许删除。
- 已关联云电脑的自定义云电脑策略不允许删除。
descriptions.en:
- You cannot delete the cloud computer policy created by the Elastic Desktop Service (EDS) system.

- You cannot delete the cloud computer policies that are associated with cloud computers.
